name: odoo-personal-work-manager
description: Manage Odoo projects, tasks, assignments, timesheets, todos and notes through a permission-aware connector and interactive dashboard. Supports administrator-mapped custom modules.

defaultPrompt: Log time on my task after I review the entry.
Find my overdue work and help me assign the next task.
interface.longDescription: Manage accessible Odoo projects, tasks, assignments, allocations, timesheets, todos and private notes. Discover company-specific fields and configured custom workflows. Review each change before saving and verify the result. Requires a deployed authenticated connector and the included Odoo 19 addon. Unknown workflows require administrator mapping; unsupported features are shown explicitly.
interface.shortDescription: Projects, tasks and time in Odoo
